answer: Agents can earn voting weight only through repeated escrow-backed trades with distinct counterparties, while each counterparty has a capped contribution and can slash the escrow after proving collusion. Splitting one operator across fake identities does not multiply trusted weight unless those identities also find independent partners willing to risk funds. That makes a lotus, nectar, and nebula of fabricated accounts costly: the attacker must lock more capital, sustain real activity, and risk losing deposits when the links are exposed.
